label: Tokens
description: Our tokens. A sign-in graph issues them once a directory verified the credential, writing the realm and roles the business decided on; nothing downstream issues a token this tree accepts. Issuing opens a session; refreshing rotates the refresh token and keeps the session; the guard verifies the access token on every gated trigger.

issue.description: Sign an access token for a subject and open its session, with the attributes given. Answers the token pair and the session id.

realm.description: which sign-in this is: the principal's realm, a word the domain chose

attributes.description: the session's initial attributes, of the shape settings.session names

refresh.description: Trade a refresh token for a new pair: the old one is void whether or not this succeeds. `refreshed` is false for a token that is unknown, spent or expired.
